digest.en: The U.S. says it will not obstruct Venezuela Opposition leader Juan Guaido's return, while Mexico asks US state attorneys general to investigate immigrant ICE deaths. Luxury hotels are setting sail, but their ability to master life at sea remains uncertain.
digest.hi: फ्रांस में इच्छामृत्यु को हरी झंडी मिल गई है, नए कानून के अनुसार मरीज अब गरिमा से विदा होंगे। यह निर्णय फ्रांस के सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने लिया है, जिसमें कहा गया है कि मरीज की इच्छा को पूरा करने के लिए डॉक्टरों को पूरी स्वतंत्रता दी जाएगी।

articles.title: U.S. says will not obstruct Venezuela Opposition leader's return
articles.summary: Now, I do think that there's some work we need to do in the context of Venezuela, so that way, when she returns, she doesn't get arrested, says Deputy Assistant Secretary for South America Luis Mendez U. S. says will not obstruct Venezuela Opposition leader's return.

articles.title: Luxury hotels are setting sail – but can they master life at sea?
articles.summary: Four Seasons, Orient Express and Aman are bringing their familiar brand of service to the water, with vast suites, private butlers and superyacht-style itineraries. The experience is impressive, though not always as seamless as the price suggests. Luxury hotels are setting sail – but can they master life at sea?

articles.title: Mexico asks US state attorneys general to investigate immigrant ICE deaths
articles.summary: Since start of Trump’s second term, 14 Mexican immigrants have died in ICE custody and three in agency operationsMexico formally requested that US state attorneys general criminally investigate cases of immigrants who have died in Immigration and Customs Enforcement custody or during raids, the Mexican government said Tuesday. The request follows the death of Mexican immigrant Lorenzo Salgado Arauj Mexico asks US state attorneys general to investigate immigrant ICE deaths.

articles.title: Brought in for civilian use, Starlink is now integral to Ukraine’s war effort
articles.summary: Russia’s latest attempts to jam the satellite network are about more than disrupting internet access; Starlink sits behind drone operations, battlefield communications, and command networks that stretch across hundreds of kilometres of the war front Brought in for civilian use, Starlink is now integral to Ukraine’s war effort.

articles.title: The Shadowy Iranian Judge Sending Protesters To Their Death
articles.summary: Iran has executed some 40 political prisoners since mass protests rocked the country in January. Twelve more may be about to join them, and they were all put on death row by one man: Mohammad Reza Tavakoli, honored by the judiciary as an “exemplary judge.” The Shadowy Iranian Judge Sending Protesters To Their Death.

articles.title: US Strikes Target Iranian Ports, Continues Shipping Blockade
articles.summary: A new round of US strikes across Iran hit dozens of military targets in areas near the Strait of Hormuz, including missile storage and launch sites on Greater Tunb island, according to western military officials. US Strikes Target Iranian Ports, Continues Shipping Blockade.

articles.title: Buffett says decision to stop Gates Foundation donations not a surprise
articles.summary: He now ⁠wants the shares distributed by the end of 2034, rather than 10 years after his death. He noted his children’s advancing ages. Susie Buffett, ‌the oldest, will be 81 by the end of 2034 Buffett says decision to stop Gates Foundation donations not a surprise.

articles.title: Leaving U.K. in better shape: Keir Starmer at final Parliament session as PM
articles.summary: Andy Burnham, the former Mayor of Greater Manchester, is on course to take charge as the new British Prime Minister next week after being endorsed by a resounding 349 Labour MPs in the leadership race Leaving U. K. in better shape: Keir Starmer at final Parliament session as PM. Leaving U. Leaving U. K.

articles.title: New guidance offers hope for reducing the global toll of dementia
articles.summary: The World Health Organization (WHO) has issued updated global guidelines aimed at reducing the risk of cognitive decline and dementia, saying that up to 45 per cent of cases may be preventable or delayed by addressing modifiable risk factors throughout life. New guidance offers hope for reducing the global toll of dementia.

articles.title: 'Eventually They'll Return To The Table': Middle East Expert Gause Sees Diplomacy Surviving US-Iran
articles.summary: Despite renewed US strikes on Iran and attacks around the Gulf, veteran Middle East scholar Francis Gregory Gause argues that diplomacy is still alive, and that both Washington and Tehran are once again maneuvering to strengthen their positions before an eventual return to negotiations. 'Eventually They'll Return To The Table': Middle East Expert Gause Sees Diplomacy Surviving US-Iran.

articles.title: Why Asia’s AI investment is outpacing AI outcomes
articles.summary: AI has become one of the few technologies in recent memory that organizations are simultaneously overestimating and underpreparing for. Across Asia-Pacific, investment levels suggest extraordinary confidence in AI’s ability to reshape enterprise performance. The organizational foundations required to realize that value tell a rather different story. KPMG’s inaugural Global AI Pulse survey, publish Why Asia’s AI investment is outpacing AI outcomes.

articles.title: Shipwrecks of Shackleton and Scott recreated in 3D digital form after deep sea expedition
articles.summary: Canadian scientists visit remains of polar exploration vessels in ‘golden era for shipwreck investigating’Moments after devouring the final glimmers of light, the seafloor offered nothing but darkness and silt. Then the bow appeared. Shipwrecks of Shackleton and Scott recreated in 3D digital form after deep sea expedition.

articles.title: China’s savvy pivot in courting Muslim Indonesia
articles.summary: Beijing’s long courtship of Indonesia’s Muslim communities reached a new milestone this month, when the Majelis Ulama Indonesia (MUI), the nation’s top body of Islamic scholars, traveled to China. The five-day “Digital Silk Road” program brought MUI council members to Guangzhou and Shenzhen, with a focus on technology, halal industries, education and cultural exchange. But [] The post China’s sav.

articles.title: US Senate Unveils Revised Russia Sanctions Bill As Lawmakers Push To Cement Graham's Legacy
articles.summary: A bipartisan group of US senators on July 14 introduced the Sanctioning Russia Act of 2026, unveiling a revised package of sanctions and tariffs aimed at squeezing Moscow's war finances while seeking to overcome concerns that had stalled earlier versions of the legislation. US Senate Unveils Revised Russia Sanctions Bill As Lawmakers Push To Cement Graham's Legacy.

articles.title: After Double Amputation, Ukrainian Vet Says 'Thirst For Independence' Led The Way To Recovery
articles.summary: Ukrainian soldier Artem lost both his arms in combat near Pokrovske, a frontline village in Ukraine's Dnipropetrovsk region. Recovering from his injuries has meant relearning how to do daily activities -- from getting dressed to working at a computer. After Double Amputation, Ukrainian Vet Says 'Thirst For Independence' Led The Way To Recovery.

articles.title: Why The US-Iran Conflict Keeps Shifting Between Fighting And Diplomacy
articles.summary: As the US and Iran exchange new strikes, military analyst Jonathan Schroden explains why wars often become more violent before peace, how the Strait of Hormuz has become the conflict's strategic centre, and why drones are reshaping naval warfare. Why The US-Iran Conflict Keeps Shifting Between Fighting And Diplomacy.

articles.title: Death toll reaches 30 as police say negligence is ‘primary theory’
articles.summary: Bar owner in Thailand offers ‘deepest apologies for this tragic incident’ as police investigate whether exits were either blocked or hard to accessThe Bangkok pub that has become the scene of the city’s deadliest blaze in 17 years has said it will cooperate with an investigation into alleged negligence, as the death toll rose to 30. Death toll reaches 30 as police investigate negligence as ‘primary theory’.

articles.title: Skills for an uncertain future: How youth can navigate a changing job market
articles.summary: Choosing a path for the future has never been easy, but for young people today, such rapid technological change as artificial intelligence (AI) is making it increasingly difficult to predict which skills will remain relevant in the years ahead. Skills for an uncertain future: How youth can navigate a changing job market.

articles.title: World Cup football’s other goal: Helping young people talk about mental health
articles.summary: When Dr. Sahira Al Nahari founded Shifā Art, a Saudi Arabia-based organization using art to create conversations around mental health, she noticed that men attending her therapeutic art workshops often felt uncomfortable opening up about their feelings. World Cup football’s other goal: Helping young people talk about mental health.

articles.title: ‘Cycle of escalation must end’: UN condemns deadly Strait of Hormuz attacks
articles.summary: The UN maritime agency, IMO, condemned overnight attacks on shipping in and around the Strait of Hormuz that killed at least two seafarers as fresh strikes were reported early Tuesday in the escalating US-Iran war. ‘Cycle of escalation must end’: UN condemns deadly Strait of Hormuz attacks.

articles.summary: अर्जेंटीना ने फीफा विश्व कप फाइनल में जापान को हराकर खिताब जीत लिया। लियोनेल मेसी ने मैच का पहला गोल किया। अर्जेंटीना ने 4-2 से जीत हासिल की। शरद पवार ने कहा कि वह एनडीए में शामिल हो सकते हैं अगर उन्हें पार्टी का नेतृत्व करने का मौका मिले। पवार ने कहा कि उन्हें एनडीए के नेताओं से बात करने के बाद यह फैसला किया है। उन्होंने कहा कि वह एनडीए के लिए काम करने के लिए तैयार हैं। उत्तर प्रदेश के शामली जिले में राम मंदिर के चढ़ावे की चोरी का आरोप लगाया गया है। पुलिस ने कहा कि चोरी की जांच की जा रही है और आरोपियों को जल्द ही गिरफ्तार किया जाएगा।
